description: Custom 'deploy' command (ssh + systemctl) that passes the deploy regex but fails platform detection. Reproduces the audit's 'platform fallback to unknown' anti-pattern: capture-deployment.sh emits a memory whose CONTENT contains 'on unknown' and METADATA has platform='unknown'. The hook explicitly excludes 'unknown' from the tag list (capture-deployment.sh:258-259), so the audit artifact lives in content+metadata, not tags — see docs/session_2026-04-28_hook_replay.md finding D.
adversarial_twist: high — exercises platform-fallback anti-pattern flagged in audit finding #3 (Tag-discipline drift)

expected_anti_patterns_in_emitted_memory: content should contain the substring 'on unknown' (platform-fallback bleed into content)
tags should NOT contain 'unknown' — the hook filters it out, which is why the artifact lives in content/metadata
